purpose: Freeze source-transfer evidence treatment and session-clustered no-order shadow sufficiency without authorizing collection or orders.

recorder_governance.insufficient_existing_development_pairs: source_transfer_insufficient; historical component research may continue, but decision-shadow, live-shadow, and paper activation remain blocked

historical_to_IBKR_source_transfer.allowed_population: already-recorded sessions classified development by the sealed-day governance manifest
forbidden_population: new recorder sessions under this repair

tolerances.extension_inactive: exact inactive mask and zero model contribution
tolerances.complete_ladder_and_reset_actions: exact WAIT while flat and exact safe HOLD/EXIT precedence while open

score_gap_p95.quantity: absolute historical-minus-IBKR difference in selected-cluster-versus-best-outside-cluster primary-score gap
score_gap_p95.estimator: nearest-rank order statistic ceil(0.95*n), one-based, no interpolation
score_gap_p95.zero_only_if: every paired score gap is bit-identical

historical_to_IBKR_source_transfer.pass: Every identity, minimum, present stratum, tolerance, action-agreement, and p95 artifact requirement passes and independently reproduces.
historical_to_IBKR_source_transfer.activation_boundary: A pass is mandatory before FT2-92 or any Phase-F live observation; a pass does not authorize orders.

minimum_no_order_live_shadow_evidence.complete_session_definition: Every scheduled flat and open decision boundary reconstructs with timestamps, masks, exact identities, feature hashes, scores, actions, block reasons, account state, and lifecycle state.
minimum_no_order_live_shadow_evidence.regime_coverage: at least one complete session in the training-defined top volatility tercile

paired_live_planes.reference: Frozen historical-style canonical feature builder and model bundle operating on causally available live observations.
paired_live_planes.runtime: Production-intended M5 or Gateway no-order path.

safety_actions.observed_denominator_zero: report not_observed_live; synthetic guard fixtures remain mandatory and do not fabricate live evidence

session_clustered_agreement_gates.threshold_interval_logic: A lower-bound threshold passes only when the conservative session-cluster lower bound meets it. An interval overlapping the threshold is insufficient_shadow_evidence; a sufficiently evidenced upper bound below the threshold is shadow_transfer_fail.

runtime_integrity.global_complete_ladder: A missing, stale, reconnecting, or partially rebuilt slot forces WAIT while flat; while open it follows the frozen HOLD/floor/forced-flat safety precedence.
runtime_integrity.freshness_and_opening_history: FT2-08 v2 executable timestamp, warmup, reset, and complete-history laws reproduce exactly.
runtime_integrity.decision_deadline: Every decision completes before the next completed-minute boundary.
runtime_integrity.reconstructability: Every action and abstention reproduces from the frozen bundle and hashed live input row.

terminal_rules.shadow_pass: All source-transfer prerequisite, minimum counts, regime coverage, clustered agreement gates, safety rules, runtime integrity, and independent reproduction pass.
terminal_rules.insufficient_shadow_evidence: Integrity is valid but a minimum denominator, session-cluster bound, or regime requirement is unresolved.
terminal_rules.shadow_transfer_fail: Sufficient paired evidence exists and an agreement or runtime behavior bound fails.
terminal_rules.invalid_shadow_evidence: Identity, hash, causality, feature, timestamp, feed, pairing, or reproduction failure prevents interpretation.
